desc:
Step into NEMESIS, a high-speed FPS where movement is your greatest weapon. Wall-run, vault, and chain parkour to outmaneuver enemies in an intense FFA deathmatch and DUELS!

⚡ BETA  LIVE ⚡
🌀  Momentum-based combat with wall-running, vaulting, mantling, and slides
🛠️ Unlock weapons, abilities, wraps, tracers, charms, finishers and MORE!
🔥 Activate tactical abilities to turn the tide of battle
📱 Play on PC, Mobile, Tablet and Console
🎁 Join the group for exclusive Alpha rewards!

⚠️ The game is now in BETA, if you see any bugs please report them to us and we'll fix them immediately! ⚠️

💜 Made by RoyalFire Studios! 💚
